scope: Name spelling, scientific authority, accepted genus/family, synonym/identity mapping only; no county nativity, specimen photos, or canonical card changes.
taxonomic_backbone: POWO/WCVP (broad Boraginaceae); legacy alternative families preserved in Master Pool as separate display policy until explicit family reconciliation

records.authority_source: Kew Plants of the World Online / World Checklist of Vascular Plants, accessed 2026-10-14
records.notes: POWO accepts the orchid name; synonym Corallorhiza elliptica Schltr. is a different historical name, not a second learner concept.

records.authority_source: Kew Plants of the World Online / World Checklist of Vascular Plants, accessed 2026-10-14
records.notes: Kew accepts Cordia boissieri but includes Cordia in broad Boraginaceae; Master Pool currently lists Cordiaceae, a narrower family circumscription used by other taxonomic treatments. Preserve existing family index and record taxonomy-backbone mismatch for deliberate later reconciliation. Lithocardium boissieri is a synonym.

records.notes: Accepted Cornus drummondii. Swida drummondii (C.A.Mey.) Soják is a homotypic synonym; retain as optional search alias, no duplicate.

records.authority_source: Kew Plants of the World Online / World Checklist of Vascular Plants, accessed 2026-10-14
records.notes: POWO accepts Coryphantha echinus; Mammillaria echinus Engelm. is a homotypic synonym. Do not conflate with other Coryphantha species.

records.authority_source: Kew Plants of the World Online / World Checklist of Vascular Plants, accessed 2026-10-14
records.notes: The source name omits its infraspecific rank. Under POWO 2022 taxonomy Coryphantha macromeris is a synonym of accepted Pelecyphora macromeris (Engelm.) D.Aquino & Dan.Sánchez, with accepted subsp. macromeris (autonym) and subsp. runyonii. If source intends the nominotypical subspecies, map to Pelecyphora macromeris subsp. macromeris, but do NOT certify infraspecific observation identity or add a duplicate card without source rank/voucher verification. ITIS uses Coryphantha macromeris subsp. macromeris as an older concept.

records.authority_source: Kew Plants of the World Online / World Checklist of Vascular Plants, accessed 2026-10-14
records.notes: POWO accepts Coryphantha sulcata; Mammillaria sulcata Engelm. is a homotypic synonym. Retain species separate from C. echinus.

records.notes: POWO accepts Cotinus obovatus Raf.; Cotinus americanus Nutt. is a heterotypic synonym (historical North American smoketree name).
